products.label: A
products.reason: It is a monitoring and automation application for heat exchangers, which fits the firm’s existing wastewater monitoring, control, and heat-recovery activities but is not the same product type.

products.label: B
products.reason: A web tool for weir dimensioning builds on the firm’s existing weir and gate products, but it is a design/planning tool rather than an operating system or physical component.

products.label: C
products.reason: A fouling detection system for heat exchangers uses the same industrial monitoring and contamination-detection expertise as the firm’s existing control and sensor products, but for a new asset class.

products.label: D
products.reason: A spring-controlled flap weir is the same kind of water-control product as the firm’s existing flap weirs and gates, differing mainly in the actuation mechanism.

products.label: E
products.reason: An energy management system for water facilities extends the firm’s existing operations management and SCADA software for utility infrastructure into a closely adjacent function.

products.label: F
products.reason: An overflow flap gate for water level regulation is the same general product family as the firm’s existing flap weirs and gates for controlling flow and levels.
